title: unified-rollouts: enhance canary + shadow + A/B auto-rollback policy and observability
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: customers running progressive model rollouts (canary, A/B, and shadow) need stronger automated rollback guarantees and clearer observability to reduce incident MTTR. This change extends the unified-rollouts controller to support multi-metric auto-rollback policies, improved metric matching for shadow traffic, and stricter stability guards for canary/A-B phases.

Changes included (high level):
- Introduced a new AutoRollbackPolicy CRD field: `stability_window` and `consecutive_evaluations` to reduce flapping during noisy metric windows.
- Multi-metric thresholds: support for AND/OR expressions across latency, error-rate, and qualitative quality score (from evaluator) for decisioning.
- Shadow metric matching: ability to match shadow request attributes (route, model-variant, prompt-shard) so shadow-based regression signals are correctly correlated.
- Rollout state machine guardrails: add `stall_on_inconclusive` and `escalate_on_violation` flags to require manual approval after repeated inconclusive checks.
- Observability: emit per-rollout metric labels (rollout_id, phase, variant) and a new histogram for rollback-latency so SLOs can be tracked.
- E2E and unit tests: new harness for simulating shadow traffic regressions and multi-metric trigger scenarios.

Why this approach: Previously we observed false positives for rollback due to single-metric noise and mis-attributed shadow signals. Combining multiple metrics and enforcing consecutive evaluations reduces spurious rollbacks while maintaining safety. Adding explicit matching for shadow traffic fixes attribution errors when shadowed requests differ by route or prompt shard.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-3245)
- [x] New API fields documented in rollout schema
- [x] Unit tests (controller + policy eval)
- [x] Integration tests in perf-canary harness
- [x] Console metrics dashboard panels added (observability-pack)
- [x] Backwards compatible default behavior when policy fields are omitted

Testing and rollout plan: 
- Feature gated behind runtime flag `rollouts.multi_metric_autorollback` (off by default).
- Deploy to staging with perf-canary scenarios for 48h; monitor rollback-latency and false-positive rate.
- Gradual enablement for customers using canary by toggling flag per-org; initial rollout to internal accounts.

Related: ENG-3245 (design), PM-1122 (product requirements), SUP-4481 (customer case that motivated shadow matching).

Notes on compatibility: default policy values preserve existing single-metric behavior. No change required in existing rollout manifests.

Release notes: Adds multi-metric auto-rollback policy and improved shadow-traffic matching for unified rollouts; feature off by default. See release_notes field for short blurb.
